description: Registry of diagnostic checks for SkillSpring governance, datasets, enforcement, and pipeline behavior.

diagnostics.name: Trigger Registry Integrity
diagnostics.purpose: Ensure trigger registry exists, is valid JSON, and contains no authority-granting fields.

diagnostics.name: Dataset Presence Check
diagnostics.purpose: Ensure required datasets are present and versioned.

diagnostics.name: Triggerâ€“Dataset Mapping Coverage
diagnostics.purpose: Ensure every trigger is mapped to at least one dataset.

diagnostics.name: Output Admissibility Schema Validation
diagnostics.purpose: Ensure output admissibility schema exists and forbids additional properties.

diagnostics.name: Pipeline Fail-Closed Behavior
diagnostics.purpose: Ensure end-to-end pipeline enforces control, execution, and output gating without bypass.

diagnostics.name: Refusal Code Preservation
diagnostics.purpose: Ensure OutputGate does not rewrite an upstream refusal.code; it may only normalize/enrich/bind.

diagnostics.name: Failure Registry Completeness
diagnostics.purpose: Ensure every failure_code used in code exists in the canonical registry.

diagnostics.name: Allow Output Preservation
diagnostics.purpose: Ensure OutputGate does not downgrade ok:true outputs without explicit invariant breach.

diagnostics.name: Registry Change Protocol Enforcement
diagnostics.purpose: Enforce append-only versioning: no edits to *.vN.json; new versions require generated TS, registryIndex update, and CHANGELOG entry.
